county_records.authority: original SEC directory fragment + exact source-substring + derived text and literal outbound links
county_records.historical_source_pins: complete observations; body/metadata paths remain relative to data/turnout

source_index.original_bytes: raw HTTP response entity as obtained; entity encoding retained (requests form results explicitly content-decoded)
source_index.original_sha256: hash of those preserved entity bytes before lossless storage gzip
source_index.stored_sha256: hash of stored gzip wrapper bytes
source_index.complete: true only for complete bounded acquired entity; oversized partial entities not admitted
source_index.http200: does not establish parse success; error/challenge/maintenance bodies remain
source_index.shared_body: identical entity may have independent observation metadata and shared original body

raw_position_pointers.DB_JSON: RFC6901-style pointers; raw granular rows include all flags and pseudocontrols

raw_position_pointers.ENR_JSON: complete source object at pointer plus exact native label and candidate vector ordinal; no stable numericunit ID inferred from ordinals
raw_position_pointers.TXT: original line_ordinal plus field column_ordinal; no rounding or gap fill

identity_namespaces: FIPS/native DB IDs/ENRkeys+ordinals/VHMrequestedcounty+codes/candidate trackingIDs are distinct; no cross-year/current join approved
validation: deterministic offline output; no fetch or collector
asset_manifest: complete owned artifacts plus report/CSV, self-exclusion only; contains validation hash; validation does not embed manifest hash to avoid circularity
raw_source_preservation: all complete originalbytes and raw position files reused by pinned hash; derivatives never replace originals
